pedagogy.motivation: When statistical models or likelihood densities are misspecified, standard ML variance estimates fail. White's sandwich estimator provides misspecification-robust covariance standard errors across Time Series, ML, Econometrics, and Signal Processing.

assumptions: Sample size T is sufficiently large
True parameter θ0 lies in interior of parameter space

math_model.label: Score Vector
math_model.intuition: The gradient of individual log-likelihoods measuring parameter sensitivity.

math_model.label: Hessian Matrix (I_2D)
math_model.intuition: Second-derivative curvature estimate of the log-likelihood surface.

math_model.label: Outer-Product of Scores (I_OP)
math_model.intuition: Empirical covariance matrix of individual gradient scores.

math_model.label: Sandwich Covariance Formula
math_model.intuition: The robust variance-covariance matrix sandwiching the score outer-product between inverse Hessians.
